<title>Gold Glow Gate</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600;700&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,600;1,8..60,400&display=swap">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#061009;--panel:#0b1710;--line:#1f2d24;--ink:#F0EAD6;--muted:#93a097;--gold:#C9A84C;--glit:#F3E0A6;--sel:#13200f}
html,body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
body{font:15px/1.55 'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif;padding-inline:16px;padding-block:22px 56px}
.wrap{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;gap:16px}
.eyebrow{font:700 12px/1.3 Rajdhani,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin:0}
h1{font:700 clamp(30px,4.4vw,48px)/1.02 Rajdhani,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;margin:6px 0 8px;text-wrap:balance}
.lede{max-width:82ch;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.lede b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
h2{font:700 13px/1.3 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 10px}
a{color:var(--glit)}
#frame{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:874/402;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#040605;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 30px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
.bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pill,#chapters button,.looks button{font:700 14px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pill:hover,#chapters button:hover,.looks button:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
#reel{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3E0A6,#C9A84C 48%,#A8832B);color:#1d1606;border-color:#F3E0A6}
#reel[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--sel);color:var(--glit);border-color:var(--gold)}
#snd[aria-pressed="false"]{color:var(--muted)}
.hint{font:600 14px/1.3 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.03em;margin-left:auto}
#chapters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
#chapters button .n{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}
#chapters button[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--sel);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--glit)}
#prog{height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:#15211a;overflow:hidden}
#prog i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6b5a33,var(--gold))}
#cap{display:grid;gap:8px}
#cap h3{font:700 20px/1.1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0}
#cap p{margin:0;max-width:86ch;color:var(--muted)}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tags span{font:600 13px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel)}
.tags span b{color:var(--glit);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;margin-right:6px}
.looks{display:grid;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px}
.looks .lk{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.looks .lk>span{font:700 12px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);width:64px;flex:none}
.looks button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--sel);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--glit)}
.sw{width:22px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15);display:inline-grid;place-items:center}
.sw i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px}
@media (max-width:860px){.cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}
th{font:700 12px/1.3 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);text-align:left;padding:0 12px 6px 0}
td{padding:7px 12px 7px 0;border-top:1px solid #16221b;vertical-align:top}
td:first-child{font:700 14px/1.35 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);width:24%}
td.new{color:var(--glit)}
td code,li code{font:13px/1.3 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#d7c9a3}
.snd td:first-child{font:15px/1.4 'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif;width:auto;color:var(--muted)}
button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}

/* ---------- the table, 874 x 402 ---------- */
#stage{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:874px;height:402px;transform-origin:0 0;overflow:hidden;background:#040605;font-family:Rajdhani,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;color:#F0EAD6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;--shx:0px;--shy:3px;user-select:none}
#world,#hud,#top{position:absolute;inset:0}
#hud,#top{pointer-events:none}
#world{will-change:transform}
#world>*{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:874px;height:402px;pointer-events:none}
#bg,#gl{transform-origin:50% 55%}
#shade{background:#000;opacity:0}
#dim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#flash{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(255,222,150,.5)}
.card{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#FFFDF7,#F7F4EA 55%,#E6E1D2);border:1px solid rgba(90,78,52,.45);box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 #D6D0BC,0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3),var(--shx) var(--shy) 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5);overflow:hidden}
.card svg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block}
.card image{mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.card .gl{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.card.bkc{border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.45);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4),var(--shx) var(--shy) 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.card.hi{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #F3E0A6,0 0 22px rgba(243,224,166,.7),var(--shx) var(--shy) 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#hand .card{transition:top .12s ease-out}
.grp{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:457px 222px;transition:transform .28s ease-out,filter .28s}
.grp.prev{transform:translateY(9px) rotate(-7deg);filter:brightness(.6)}
.seat{position:absolute;width:0;height:0}
.nm{position:absolute;top:-33.5px;left:-60px;width:120px;text-align:center;font:600 11.34px/11px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.55px;color:rgba(240,234,214,.58);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .2s}
.disc{position:absolute;left:-17px;top:-17px;width:34px;height:34px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12402A 20%,#061C12);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.2);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 13.4px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#F0EAD6;transition:box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
.seat.on .disc{border-color:rgba(243,224,166,.7);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(243,224,166,.35)}
.seat.on .nm{color:#F3E0A6}
.ring{position:absolute;inset:-6px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#F3E0A6 calc(var(--p,100) * 1%),rgba(201,168,76,.14) 0);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));opacity:0;transition:opacity .1s}
.seat.on .ring{opacity:1;transition:opacity .1s .1s}
.badge{position:absolute;left:19.7px;top:19.7px;width:18.55px;height:18.55px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:#03110A;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 10.3px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#E2C06A}
.badge.won{background:#C9A84C;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.15)}
.badge.last{transform:scale(1.25);background:#9e1f26;border-color:#ffb3a0;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,90,70,.6)}
.passo{position:absolute;height:15px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.35);background:rgba(3,14,9,.85);color:rgba(240,234,214,.7);font:700 8px/13px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap}
.seat[data-side="top"] .passo{left:-60px;top:-8px}
.seat[data-side="side"] .passo{left:0;top:27px}
.fan{position:absolute;width:0;height:0}
.bk{position:absolute;width:24.5px;height:43.5px;margin:-21.75px 0 0 -12.25px;border-radius:2.4px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .7px rgba(201,168,76,.45),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#fly .bk{left:0;top:0;margin:0}
.knob{position:absolute;left:6.3px;width:45.35px;height:45.35px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:auto}
#menu{top:13.4px}#react{top:343.25px}
#menu i{display:block;width:15px;height:1.8px;border-radius:1px;background:rgba(240,234,214,.58);box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(240,234,214,.58),0 -5px 0 rgba(240,234,214,.58)}
.chip{position:absolute;top:13.4px;height:23.7px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(3,14,9,.72);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 10px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.55px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,234,214,.58);white-space:nowrap}
.chip b{color:#C9A84C;font-weight:700}
#combo{left:68.3px}
#turn{left:457px;transform:translateX(-50%);gap:7px;padding:0 13px;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,color .2s}
#turn .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(201,168,76,.8)}
#turn b{color:#F3E0A6;font-size:12px;min-width:13px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#turn.lit{color:#F3E0A6;border-color:rgba(243,224,166,.8);box-shadow:0 0 20.6px rgba(243,224,166,.28)}
#turn.lit .dot{background:#F3E0A6;box-shadow:0 0 6px #F3E0A6}

#turn.urgent .dot{background:#ff7a45;box-shadow:0 0 6px #ff7a45}#turn.urgent b{color:#ffb08a}
#turn.net .dot{animation:blink .9s ease-in-out infinite}
#turn.ok{color:#d4ecce;border-color:rgba(143,191,138,.7)}#turn.ok .dot{background:#8fbf8a}
#turn.bad{color:#ffcfc6;border-color:#d0574b}#turn.bad .dot{background:#e0806f}
#turn u{text-decoration:none;background:#C9A84C;color:#17130a;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 7px;letter-spacing:1px}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.cchip{position:absolute;left:457px;top:282px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);height:15px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);font:700 9px/13px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#C9A84C;text-transform:uppercase}
.act{position:absolute;top:345px;width:57.7px;height:57.7px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:14.4px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12.37px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.96px;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:rgba(240,234,214,.4);box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.18)}
#passa{left:58.5px}#gioca{left:799px}
#passa.lit{color:#F0EAD6;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.55)}
#gioca.lit{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3E0A6,#C9A84C 48%,#A8832B);border:1px solid #F3E0A6;color:#2a1f08;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 26.8px rgba(243,224,166,.35)}
.floatchip{position:absolute;left:457px;top:300px;transform:translateX(-50%)}

/* the score pill: a chip at rest, a panel when open, today's board at the end of a partita */
#score{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,36,26,.95),rgba(3,14,9,.93) 60%);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.45);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto}

.rw .bar{position:relative;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(240,234,214,.08)}
.rw .bar::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-1px;top:-2px;width:1px;height:8px;background:rgba(243,224,166,.45)}

.rw .t{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:#F0EAD6;text-align:right}

#score .bx{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:150px;height:252px;border-right:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);display:grid;align-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:6px;text-align:center}

.seat{position:absolute;width:0;height:0}
.nm{position:absolute;top:-33.5px;left:-60px;width:120px;text-align:center;font:600 11.34px/11px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.55px;color:rgba(240,234,214,.58);text-transform:uppercase}
.disc{position:absolute;left:-17px;top:-17px;width:34px;height:34px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12402A 20%,#061C12);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.2);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 13.4px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#F0EAD6}
.seat.on .disc{border-color:rgba(243,224,166,.7);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(243,224,166,.35)}
.seat.on .nm{color:#F3E0A6}
.seat.gone .disc,.seat.gone .nm{opacity:.38}
.ring{position:absolute;inset:-6px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#F3E0A6 calc(var(--p,100) * 1%),rgba(201,168,76,.14) 0);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 2px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));opacity:0}
.seat.on .ring{opacity:1}
.badge{position:absolute;left:19.7px;top:19.7px;width:18.55px;height:18.55px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:#03110A;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 10.3px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#E2C06A}
.badge.won{background:#C9A84C;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.15)}
.badge.last{transform:scale(1.25);background:#9e1f26;border-color:#ffb3a0;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,90,70,.6)}
.fan{position:absolute;width:0;height:0}
.bk{position:absolute;width:24.5px;height:43.5px;margin:-21.75px 0 0 -12.25px;border-radius:2.4px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .7px rgba(201,168,76,.45),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.knob{position:absolute;left:6.3px;width:45.35px;height:45.35px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);display:grid;place-items:center}
.kmenu{top:13.4px}.kreact{top:343.25px}
.kmenu i{display:block;width:15px;height:1.8px;border-radius:1px;background:rgba(240,234,214,.58);box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(240,234,214,.58),0 -5px 0 rgba(240,234,214,.58)}
.chip{position:absolute;top:13.4px;height:23.7px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(3,14,9,.72);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 10px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.55px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(240,234,214,.58);white-space:nowrap}
.chip b{color:#C9A84C;font-weight:700}
.combo{left:68.3px}
.turn{left:457px;transform:translateX(-50%);gap:7px;padding:0 13px}
.turn .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#C9A84C}
.turn b{color:#F3E0A6;font-size:12px;min-width:13px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.turn.lit{color:#F3E0A6;border-color:rgba(243,224,166,.8);box-shadow:0 0 20.6px rgba(243,224,166,.28)}
.turn.lit .dot{background:#F3E0A6;box-shadow:0 0 6px #F3E0A6}
.cchip{position:absolute;left:457px;top:282px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);height:15px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);font:700 10px/13px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#C9A84C;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.act{position:absolute;top:345px;width:57.7px;height:57.7px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:14.4px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12.37px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.96px;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:rgba(240,234,214,.4);box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.18)}
.passa{left:58.5px}.gioca{left:799px}
.passa.lit{color:#F0EAD6;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.5)}
.gioca.lit{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3E0A6,#C9A84C 48%,#A8832B);border:1px solid #F3E0A6;color:#2a1f08;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 26.8px rgba(243,224,166,.35)}
.score{position:absolute;left:722.2px;top:13.4px;width:124px;height:23.7px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:11.85px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,36,26,.95),rgba(3,14,9,.93) 60%);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(243,224,166,.1),0 4px 10px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.score .pc{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:0;height:21.7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 10px;white-space:nowrap}
.pc svg{flex:none}
.pc .me{font:600 9px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:rgba(240,234,214,.58);text-transform:uppercase}
.pc .tot{font:700 14px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#F3E0A6;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-left:-1px}
.pc .of{font:600 9px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:rgba(240,234,214,.42);margin-left:-5px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pc .sep{width:1px;height:11px;background:rgba(201,168,76,.3)}
.pc .rk{font:700 9.5px/1 Rajdhani,sans-serif;color:#241a06;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3E0A6,#C9A84C 55%,#A8832B);border-radius:4px;padding:2.5px 4px 2px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.score .prog{position:absolute;left:11px;right:11px;bottom:2.5px;height:1.5px;border-radius:1px;background:rgba(240,234,214,.07)}
.score .prog i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#A8832B,#F3E0A6)}
.bb{height:30px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:15px;font:700 12px/28px Rajdhani,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);background:rgba(3,14,9,.8);color:#F0EAD6;white-space:nowrap}
.bb.pri{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3E0A6,#C9A84C 48%,#A8832B);color:#2a1f08;border-color:#F3E0A6}
@media (max-width:640px){body{font-size:14px}}
